claim.quote: The data clearly favor a substantial in-medium broadening of the $\rho$ spectral function over a density-dependent shift of the $\rho$ pole mass.

name: CERES modification of the rho meson in central Pb-Au collisions

summary.plain: With the upgraded CERES detector, the electron-pair excess in central lead-gold collisions clearly favours a strong broadening of the rho meson in the medium rather than a shift of its mass.
summary.technical: e+e- pair production in central Pb-Au collisions at 158A GeV/c with the upgraded CERES spectrometer (improved mass resolution): the excess over hadron decays favours substantial in-medium broadening of the rho spectral function over a density-dependent shift of the pole mass.

title: Modification of the rho meson detected by low-mass electron-positron pairs in central Pb-Au collisions at 158 A GeV/c
why_it_matters: Together with NA60's dimuon result, supports the broadening scenario of chiral symmetry restoration.
